propertySets.name: Pset_CommunicationsApplianceTypeIpNetworkEquipment
propertySets.definition: Properties common to a IP network equipment. This property set is applied to a type or occurrence of IfcCommunicationsAppliance with predefined type of IP_NETWORK_EQUIPMENT.

properties.name: EquipmentCapacity
properties.definition: Indicates the equipment capacity of the appliance. The value is defined in bits/s.

properties.name: NumberOfCoolingFans
properties.definition: Indicates the number of cooling fans in the equipment.

properties.name: SupportedProtocol
properties.definition: Indicates the protocol supported by the IP network equipment.

properties.name: ManagingSoftware
properties.definition: Indicates the type of software responsible for managing the equipment.

properties.name: NumberOfInterfaces
properties.definition: Indicates the types of interfaces and their number in the device.

propertySets.name: Pset_IpNetworkEquipmentPHistory
propertySets.definition: Properties defining performance information for IP network equipment.

properties.name: NumberOfPackets
properties.definition: Indicates the number of packets of the IP network equipment.
